meta.contract: expected = C# TargetScoring.SelectTargetTick via ScoreTargetsJson (the wasm boundary)

scenarios.name: wounded-far-vs-healthy-near
scenarios.note: C# hpScore(0-50) prefers the wounded far mob; JS 100-d has no hp term.

scenarios.name: facing-behind-vs-ahead
scenarios.note: Equal-ish distance; C# facingScore(0-10) prefers the mob ahead; JS prefers strictly nearer.

scenarios.name: threat-range-bonus
scenarios.note: Both in melee band; agreement expected (threat bonus applies to the nearer one anyway).

scenarios.name: priority-rule-shared
scenarios.note: olthoi rule priority 10 -> +45 on both sides; both should pick the Olthoi over the nearer Drudge.

scenarios.name: priority-first-match-vs-max
scenarios.note: Two rules match 'Olthoi Soldier'. C# FirstOrDefault takes list-order first (p3 -> +10); JS takes max (p10 -> +45).

scenarios.name: stickiness-hold
scenarios.note: Locked target; alternative better by <25 -> both hold the lock.

scenarios.name: stickiness-switch
scenarios.note: SCALE-MISMATCH PROBE: 23yd-closer alt. C# distScore is 2pts/yd so +46 beats stickiness 25 -> switch; JS 100-d is 1pt/yd so +23 < 25 -> hold. The tuned constant 25 assumed the C# score scale.

scenarios.name: stickiness-switch-both
scenarios.note: 33yd-closer alt: clears the stickiness threshold on BOTH scales -> both switch (control for the scale-mismatch probe).

scenarios.name: stickiness-exact-tie
scenarios.note: Alt exactly locked+25 (hasPose=false so facing is uniform). C# argmax: strict '>' resolves by scan order (nearer alt first) -> switch; JS strict '>' -> hold.

scenarios.name: scan-grace-hold-no-alternative
scenarios.note: Locked target vanished from the world snapshot entirely. C# treats a world-filter null as a transient miss and holds through the 1500ms grace; the shipped JS tick() kill-confirms on !pos IMMEDIATELY (combat_loop.js:308-321) -> false kill + 30s suppression on a transient entity-stream miss.

scenarios.name: scan-grace-expired
scenarios.note: Locked target lost 2000ms ago (>1500) -> both drop; nothing to re-acquire.

scenarios.name: scan-grace-with-alternative
scenarios.note: Locked target LOS-blocked this tick, alternative visible. C# re-locks the alternative IMMEDIATELY (lock absent from argmax); JS holds the lock through the full 1500ms grace.

scenarios.name: recently-killed-6s
scenarios.note: Kill signal 6s ago: C# TTL is 4000ms -> re-acquirable (and nearest wins); JS TTL is 30000ms -> excluded.

scenarios.name: recently-killed-3s
scenarios.note: Kill signal 3s ago: suppressed on both sides.

scenarios.name: recently-killed-35s
scenarios.note: Kill signal 35s ago: past both TTLs -> both re-acquire.

scenarios.name: dead-not-corpse
scenarios.note: hp==0 excluded on both sides; both pick the live mob.

scenarios.name: unknown-hp-full-bonus
scenarios.note: HealthRatio -1 (no update yet) passes the ==0 filter and C# clamps -1->0 => FULL 50pt wounded bonus for an unknown-HP mob. JS ignores hp in scoring.

scenarios.name: players-excluded
scenarios.note: Players in the mix (nearer than the mob) -> both exclude, pick the monster.

scenarios.name: monster-in-player-guid-range
scenarios.note: Monster whose guid falls in 0x50000000-0x5FFFFFFF: C# classifies by ObjectClass -> includes; JS guid-range heuristic excludes it.

scenarios.name: cross-landblock-neighbor
scenarios.note: Mob in the adjacent LB, global distance 30: C# global-frame distance includes it; JS same-LB gate excludes it.

scenarios.name: distance-45
scenarios.note: Mob at 45: inside C# MonsterRange(50), outside JS's hardcoded 40 -> C# picks it, JS sees nothing.

scenarios.name: engaged-hysteresis-52
scenarios.note: Locked target stepped back to 52 (disengage = MonsterRange+3 = 53): C# retains via hysteresis; JS excludes >40 but holds via scan grace -> same chosen id by different mechanisms.

scenarios.name: engaged-hysteresis-55-with-alt
scenarios.note: Locked target at 55 (> disengage 53): C# validation drops 'out of range' and re-locks the alternative same tick; JS holds the stale lock through grace.

scenarios.name: spell-projectile-excluded
scenarios.note: 'Flame Bolt' misclassified as Monster: C# name-excludes it (T5); JS has no projectile-name filter and will target it.

scenarios.name: not-attackable-vendor
scenarios.note: Attackable=false (vendor/NPC with Monster class): both exclude.

scenarios.name: attackable-unknown-t4
scenarios.note: Desc-flags/weenie not yet populated: RynthAi T4 fails OPEN (attackable) -> C# targets it; webhost.js:346-349 fails CLOSED -> JS excludes it.

scenarios.name: blacklisted-mob
scenarios.note: Blacklisted (confirmed-miss) mob: C# excludes; the shipped JS loop has no blacklist input at all and targets it.

scenarios.name: user-never-attack
scenarios.note: User never-attack list: C# excludes; the shipped JS loop has no such input and targets it.

scenarios.name: empty-world
scenarios.note: No entities at all -> both select nothing.

scenarios.name: locked-validation-corpse
scenarios.note: Locked target reclassified to corpse (ObjectClass!=Monster): C# drops 'became corpse' and re-locks the alt same tick; JS excludes it from scan (itemType filter) and holds via grace.

scenarios.name: locked-died-hp0-with-alt
scenarios.note: Locked target hp->0 (dead-not-corpse): C# validation drops 'hp=0' and re-locks the alt same tick; JS _selectTarget holds it (its kill-check lives in tick(), one tick later).
